args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate (~18%) after the latest deploy. Mitigation: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback verification shows the service is healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failures is still under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1, the latest deploy, was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent previously healthy release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: All production regions were rolled back to v2.3.0. Verification confirms the service is now healthy with the error rate back down to **0.2%**.

3. **Opened incident**: Created **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api describing the health check failures on v2.3.1 and the mitigation (rollback to v2.3.0). The on-call engineer has been paged, and the root cause of the v2.3.1 failures remains under investigation.
